latHint: Think chopping very fine - not rolling for a six.
pivHint: You roll DICE in board games - but to DICE an onion is to cut it small. What cut is even smaller?
winText: Chop chop. DICE was the pivot - game cubes to cooking cuts like MINCE.
lossText: MINCE - to chop very fine. DICE was the pivot: board game DICE to DICE an onion.
